content: Our cancellation policy allows free rescheduling up to 24 hours before the appointment.
Appointments can be rescheduled to any available slot within the next 30 days at no charge.
Available appointment slots are weekdays between 9 AM and 5 PM, with slots at 11 AM and 3 PM on most days.
If a customer misses an appointment without notice, a no-show fee of $25 may apply to their account.
Customers can reach a human support agent by asking for a manager during any call, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM.
